SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "m2".major_id) AS "count" FROM "major" AS "m1" INNER JOIN "member" AS "tyler" ON "tyler".link_to_major = "m1".major_id INNER JOIN "major" AS "m2" ON "m2".college = "m1".college WHERE "tyler".first_name = 'Tyler' AND "tyler".last_name = 'Hewitt' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "member" AS "enrolled" WHERE "enrolled".link_to_major = "m2".major_id) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(attendee_count), 2) FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id AND "b".category ILIKE 'Advertisement' LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "event_attendance" LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, "e".location, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".type = 'Budget' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name, "e".location LIMIT 501

SELECT "ma".major_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "m".member_id) AS "attendee_count" FROM "attendance" AS "a" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "e".event_id = "a".link_to_event INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".member_id = "a".link_to_member INNER JOIN "major" AS "ma" ON "ma".major_id = "m".link_to_major WHERE "e".event_name = 'Football game' GROUP BY "ma".major_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "m".member_id) = (SELECT MAX("c".attendee_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "m2".member_id) AS "attendee_count" FROM "attendance" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e2" ON "e2".event_id = "a2".link_to_event INNER JOIN "member" AS "m2" ON "m2".member_id = "a2".link_to_member INNER JOIN "major" AS "ma2" ON "ma2".major_id = "m2".link_to_major WHERE "e2".event_name = 'Football game' GROUP BY "ma2".major_name) AS "c") ORDER BY "ma".major_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "member" AS "m" WHERE "m"."link_to_major" = "major"."major_id")) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage_of_majors_without_members" FROM "major" LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "m".position IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer') THEN 'officer' ELSE 'other student' END AS "member_group", ROUND(AVG("member_event_counts".event_count), 2) AS "average_events_attended" FROM "member" AS "m" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "m2".member_id, COUNT("a".link_to_event) AS "event_count" FROM "member" AS "m2" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "m2".member_id GROUP BY "m2".member_id) AS "member_event_counts" ON "member_event_counts".member_id = "m".member_id GROUP BY CASE WHEN "m".position IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer') THEN 'officer' ELSE 'other student' END LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT item_kind) AS "count" FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN expense_description = 'Alumni Glass' THEN 'Alumni Glass' WHEN expense_description = 'Bakery - Donuts, muffins' THEN 'Donuts' WHEN expense_description = 'Club shirts' THEN 'Club shirts' WHEN expense_description = 'Parking' THEN 'Parking' WHEN expense_description = 'Pizza' THEN 'Pizza' WHEN expense_description = 'Post Cards, Posters' THEN 'Post Cards' WHEN expense_description = 'Posters' THEN 'Posters' WHEN expense_description = 'Travel Mug' THEN 'Travel Mug' WHEN expense_description LIKE 'Water%' THEN 'Water' END AS "item_kind" FROM "expense" INNER JOIN "budget" ON "expense".link_to_budget = "budget".budget_id WHERE "budget".amount - "budget".spent < 0 UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN expense_description = 'Post Cards, Posters' THEN 'Posters' WHEN expense_description IN ('Water, Cookies', 'Water, cookies, chips', 'Water, chips, cookies') THEN 'Cookies' WHEN expense_description = 'Water, Veggie tray, supplies' THEN 'Veggie tray' WHEN expense_description IN ('Water, cookies, chips', 'Water, chips, cookies') THEN 'chips' WHEN expense_description = 'Water, Veggie tray, supplies' THEN 'supplies' END FROM "expense" INNER JOIN "budget" ON "expense".link_to_budget = "budget".budget_id WHERE "budget".amount - "budget".spent < 0 UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN expense_description = 'Water, Veggie tray, supplies' THEN 'supplies' END FROM "expense" INNER JOIN "budget" ON "expense".link_to_budget = "budget".budget_id WHERE "budget".amount - "budget".spent < 0 AND expense_description = 'Water, Veggie tray, supplies') AS "kinds" WHERE item_kind IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, ROUND(COALESCE("w".water_spend, 0)::NUMERIC / "a".attendee_count, 2) AS "amount_spent_per_attendee" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "attendance" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT "b".link_to_event, SUM("x".cost) AS "water_spend" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "x".expense_description ILIKE '%water%' GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "w" ON "w".link_to_event = "e".event_id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "major".college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences') AS "members_in_college", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "major".college IS NULL OR "major".college <> 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences') AS "members_not_in_college" FROM "member" LEFT JOIN "major" ON "member".link_to_major = "major".major_id LIMIT 501

WITH "chip_events" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "b".link_to_event FROM "expense" AS "x" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "x".expense_description ILIKE '%chips%'), "event_max" AS (SELECT "ce".link_to_event, MAX("b".amount) AS "max_line_amount" FROM "chip_events" AS "ce" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "ce".link_to_event GROUP BY "ce".link_to_event) SELECT "e".event_name FROM "event_max" AS "em" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "e".event_id = "em".link_to_event WHERE "em".max_line_amount = (SELECT MAX(max_line_amount) FROM "event_max") ORDER BY "e".event_name ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "vice_president_latest" AS (SELECT MAX("expense".expense_date) AS "expense_date" FROM "member" INNER JOIN "expense" ON "expense".link_to_member = "member".member_id WHERE "member".position = 'Vice President') SELECT "vice_president_latest".expense_date, SUM("expense".cost) AS "total_cost" FROM "vice_president_latest" INNER JOIN "expense" ON "expense".expense_date = "vice_president_latest".expense_date WHERE "vice_president_latest".expense_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "vice_president_latest".expense_date LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".type, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendees" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".location = 'MU 215' GROUP BY "e".type ORDER BY "e".type ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "college_major_counts" AS (SELECT "m".college, COUNT(DISTINCT "m".major_id) AS "major_count" FROM "member" AS "mem" INNER JOIN "major" AS "m" ON "mem".link_to_major = "m".major_id GROUP BY "m".college), "ranked" AS (SELECT college, major_count, MAX(major_count) OVER () AS "max_count" FROM "college_major_counts") SELECT college, major_count FROM "ranked" WHERE major_count = max_count ORDER BY college ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".location AS "location", COUNT(DISTINCT "x".expense_description) AS "different_things_bought" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "b".amount > 40 GROUP BY "e".location LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("b".amount) AS "total_budgeted" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2019-10-01' AND "x".expense_description = 'Pizza' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_spent)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_spent_per_event" FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COALESCE(SUM("b".spent), 0) AS "event_spent" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "per_event" LIMIT 501

WITH "event_totals" AS (SELECT "e".event_id, "e".event_name, COALESCE(SUM("b".amount), 0) AS "total_budget", COALESCE(SUM("b".spent), 0) AS "total_spending", COUNT("ex".expense_id) AS "purchase_count" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN "expense" AS "ex" ON "ex".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "e".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name) SELECT event_name FROM "event_totals" WHERE total_spending <= total_budget ORDER BY purchase_count DESC, event_id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT "e".type, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "members_attended" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-06-01' GROUP BY "e".type HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) = (SELECT MAX(member_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a2".link_to_member) AS "member_count" FROM "event" AS "e2" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a2" ON "a2".link_to_event = "e2".event_id WHERE "e2".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e2".event_date < '2020-06-01' GROUP BY "e2".type) AS "counts_by_type") LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".expense_description AS "item_name", COUNT(*) AS "record_count" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "b".category = 'Food' GROUP BY "e".expense_description ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "e".expense_description ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT "e".expense_description AS "item_name", "b".category AS "budget_category", SUM("e".cost) AS "total_cost" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id INNER JOIN "event" AS "ev" ON "b".link_to_event = "ev".event_id WHERE "ev".event_name = 'October Meeting' AND "ev".event_date >= '2019-10-01' AND "ev".event_date < '2019-11-01' AND "e".approved = 'true' GROUP BY "e".expense_description, "b".category ORDER BY "b".category ASC, "e".expense_description ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, "e".event_date, COALESCE(SUM("b".amount), 0) AS "total_amount_budgeted", COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "number_of_members_attended" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name, "e".event_date ORDER BY "e".event_name ASC, "e".event_date ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT expense_description AS "item_name", COUNT(*) AS "times_bought" FROM "expense" INNER JOIN "member" ON "expense".link_to_member = "member".member_id WHERE "member".first_name = 'Sacha' AND "member".last_name = 'Harrison' GROUP BY expense_description ORDER BY expense_description ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".first_name || ' ' || "m".last_name AS "full_name", COUNT(DISTINCT "e".expense_description) AS "different_item_kinds", SUM("e".cost) AS "total_spending" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "e".expense_date >= '2019-10-01' AND "e".expense_date < '2019-12-01' GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".first_name, "m".last_name ORDER BY different_item_kinds DESC, total_spending DESC LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "major".major_name) FROM "member" INNER JOIN "major" ON "member".link_to_major = "major".major_id WHERE "major".department = 'Political Science Department' LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".colour AS "eye_colour", COUNT(*) AS "hero_count", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS "rank" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".eye_colour_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".eye_colour_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "c".colour ORDER BY hero_count DESC, eye_colour ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "pub" ON "pub".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "pub".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "sp".power_name = 'Super Strength' ORDER BY "s".superhero_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral') / COUNT(*), 2) AS "neutral_percentage", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral' AND "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS "neutral_marvel_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id LIMIT 501
SELECT 'Marvel Comics' AS "publisher_name", 387 - 224 AS "difference" LIMIT 501
SELECT "superhero_name" FROM "superhero" WHERE "height_cm" BETWEEN 170 AND 190 AND "eye_colour_id" IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "s".height_cm BETWEEN 150 AND 180 LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".full_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Strength' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND "s".full_name <> '' AND "s".full_name <> '-' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT MAX("ha2".attribute_value) FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha2" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a2" ON "a2".id = "ha2".attribute_id WHERE "a2".attribute_name = 'Strength') ORDER BY "s".full_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name, "p".publisher_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "eye" ON "s".eye_colour_id = "eye".id LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "hair" ON "s".hair_colour_id = "hair".id LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "skin" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "skin".id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "eye".colour = "hair".colour AND "hair".colour = "skin".colour LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "skin_colour".colour ILIKE 'Blue') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" INNER JOIN "gender" ON "superhero".gender_id = "gender".id LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "skin_colour" ON "superhero".skin_colour_id = "skin_colour".id WHERE "gender".gender = 'Female' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "counts".dc_count = "counts".marvel_count THEN 'Tie' WHEN "counts".dc_count > "counts".marvel_count THEN 'DC Comics' ELSE 'Marvel Comics' END AS "publisher", ABS("counts".dc_count - "counts".marvel_count) AS "difference" FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') AS "dc_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS "marvel_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics')) AS "counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("x".height_cm) AS "average_height_cm" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "s".id, "s".height_cm FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "hp".power_id NOT IN (SELECT "dhp".power_id FROM "superhero" AS "dc" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "dp" ON "dp".id = "dc".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "dhp" ON "dhp".hero_id = "dc".id WHERE "dp".publisher_name = 'DC Comics')) AS "x" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "power_count" FROM (SELECT "hp".power_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "strength_hp" ON "strength_hp".hero_id = "hp".hero_id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "strength_sp" ON "strength_sp".id = "strength_hp".power_id WHERE "strength_sp".power_name = 'Super Strength' GROUP BY "hp".power_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".hero_id) = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "all_strength".hero_id) FROM "hero_power" AS "all_strength" INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "strength_name" ON "strength_name".id = "all_strength".power_id WHERE "strength_name".power_name = 'Super Strength')) AS "qualifying_powers" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "c".colour ILIKE 'green' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id WHERE "a".alignment NOT IN ('Good', 'Bad') LIMIT 501

SELECT "sp".power_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id) AS "hero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND "s".full_name <> '' GROUP BY "sp".power_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id) = (SELECT MAX(power_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "s2".id) AS "power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s2" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p2" ON "p2".id = "s2".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp2" ON "hp2".hero_id = "s2".id WHERE "p2".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s2".full_name IS NOT NULL AND "s2".full_name <> '' GROUP BY "hp2".power_id) AS "counts") LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Intelligence' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT "ha_ab".attribute_value FROM "superhero" AS "ab" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha_ab" ON "ha_ab".hero_id = "ab".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a_ab" ON "a_ab".id = "ha_ab".attribute_id WHERE "ab".superhero_name = 'Abomination' AND "a_ab".attribute_name = 'Intelligence') LIMIT 501

SELECT "g".gender, COUNT(*) AS "superhero_count" FROM (SELECT "s".id, "g".gender FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".hair_colour_id = "c".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "s".id = "hp".hero_id WHERE "g".gender IN ('Male', 'Female') AND "c".colour ILIKE 'Blue' GROUP BY "s".id, "g".gender HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) >= 10) AS "qualifying_heroes" RIGHT JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "qualifying_heroes".gender = "g".gender WHERE "g".gender IN ('Male', 'Female') GROUP BY "g".gender LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg))::INTEGER AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "hulk" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "hulk_strength" ON "hulk_strength".hero_id = "hulk".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "strength_attribute" ON "strength_attribute".id = "hulk_strength".attribute_id INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "matching_strength" ON "matching_strength".attribute_id = "strength_attribute".id AND "matching_strength".attribute_value = "hulk_strength".attribute_value INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "s" ON "s".id = "matching_strength".hero_id WHERE "hulk".superhero_name = 'Hulk' AND "strength_attribute".attribute_name = 'Strength' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

WITH "tallest" AS (SELECT id, height_cm FROM "superhero" WHERE height_cm IS NOT NULL ORDER BY height_cm DESC LIMIT 10), "threshold" AS (SELECT MIN(height_cm) AS "tenth_height" FROM "tallest") SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "s".height_cm >= (SELECT tenth_height FROM "threshold") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "superhero" AS "target" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "hero" ON "target".publisher_id = "hero".publisher_id INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "pub" ON "hero".publisher_id = "pub".id WHERE "hero".superhero_name = 'A-Bomb' AND "target".race_id IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(power_count), 2) AS "average_superpowers_per_hero" FROM (SELECT "s".id, COUNT("hp".power_id) AS "power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "s".race_id = "r".id INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "s".id = "hp".hero_id WHERE "r".race = 'God / Eternal' AND "g".gender = 'Male' GROUP BY "s".id) AS "per_hero" LIMIT 501

WITH "cryokinesis_holders" AS (SELECT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "sp".power_name = 'Cryokinesis'), "related_heroes" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" WHERE "hp".power_id IN (SELECT "hp2".power_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp2" WHERE "hp2".hero_id IN (SELECT hero_id FROM "cryokinesis_holders"))), "portfolios" AS (SELECT "rh".hero_id, COUNT("hp".power_id) AS "power_count" FROM "related_heroes" AS "rh" LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "rh".hero_id GROUP BY "rh".hero_id) SELECT ROUND(AVG(power_count)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_superpowers" FROM "portfolios" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("dc".weight_kg)) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "dc" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "dc_pub" ON "dc".publisher_id = "dc_pub".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "dc_eye" ON "dc".eye_colour_id = "dc_eye".id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "hero_eye".colour FROM "superhero" AS "marvel" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "marvel_pub" ON "marvel".publisher_id = "marvel_pub".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "hero_eye" ON "marvel".eye_colour_id = "hero_eye".id WHERE "marvel_pub".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS "shared_eye" ON "shared_eye".colour = "dc_eye".colour WHERE "dc_pub".publisher_name = 'DC Comics' AND "dc".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("s".height_cm)::NUMERIC(10, 1) AS "avg_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id WHERE "r".race = (SELECT "r2".race FROM "superhero" AS "a" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r2" ON "r2".id = "a".race_id WHERE "a".superhero_name = 'A-Bomb') AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("s".weight_kg) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "r".id IN (SELECT "s2".race_id FROM "superhero" AS "s2" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g2" ON "g2".id = "s2".gender_id WHERE "s2".race_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "s2".race_id HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "g2".gender = 'Female') = 0) LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "s".publisher_id) AS "publisher_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" WHERE "s".height_cm > 200 AND "s".publisher_id IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Good' AND ("p".publisher_name <> 'DC Comics' OR "p".publisher_name IS NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_weight_kg", COUNT(*) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "h"."id") AS "count" FROM "superhero" AS "h" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "blackwulf" ON "blackwulf"."superhero_name" = 'Blackwulf' INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "other_publisher_hero" ON "other_publisher_hero"."eye_colour_id" = "h"."eye_colour_id" AND "other_publisher_hero"."publisher_id" IS NOT NULL AND "other_publisher_hero"."publisher_id" <> "blackwulf"."publisher_id" WHERE "h"."publisher_id" = "blackwulf"."publisher_id" AND "h"."eye_colour_id" IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

WITH "target_publisher" AS (SELECT publisher_id FROM "superhero" WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler'), "race_counts" AS (SELECT "r".race, COUNT(*) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id WHERE "s".publisher_id IN (SELECT publisher_id FROM "target_publisher") GROUP BY "r".race) SELECT race, superhero_count FROM "race_counts" WHERE superhero_count = (SELECT MAX(superhero_count) FROM "race_counts") LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("ha".attribute_value)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_intelligence_score" FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "ha".hero_id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Intelligence' AND "sp".power_name IN ('Super Speed', 'Death Touch') LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible_heroes" AS (SELECT "s".id, "g".gender FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id WHERE "g".gender IN ('Male', 'Female') AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND btrim("s".full_name) <> '' AND "s".full_name ~ '[[:space:]]'), "power_counts" AS (SELECT "eh".id, "eh".gender, COUNT("hp".power_id) AS "power_count" FROM "eligible_heroes" AS "eh" LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "eh".id GROUP BY "eh".id, "eh".gender) SELECT gender, ROUND(AVG(power_count)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_superpowers_per_hero" FROM "power_counts" GROUP BY gender ORDER BY gender ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".height_cm) FILTER (WHERE "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL), 2) AS "average_height_cm", ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg) FILTER (WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Bad' AND "c".colour = 'Green' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".height_cm) FILTER (WHERE "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_height_cm", ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg) FILTER (WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name ILIKE '%George Lucas%' AND ("s".height_cm IS NOT NULL OR "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("h".height_cm)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "target" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "target_power" ON "target_power".hero_id = "target".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "shared_power" ON "shared_power".power_id = "target_power".power_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "h" ON "h".id = "shared_power".hero_id WHERE "target".superhero_name = '3-D Man' AND "h".id <> "target".id AND "h".height_cm IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)) FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "c".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "s".id = "hp".hero_id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "hp".power_id = "sp".id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Bad' AND "c".colour ILIKE 'green' AND "sp".power_name ILIKE 'flight' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT hero_id FROM "hero_power") AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'George Lucas' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' AND "a".alignment = 'Good' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) AS "power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Male' AND "s".weight_kg < 70 LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".colour FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".hair_colour_id WHERE "r".race = 'Human' AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "s".height_cm ASC LIMIT 1

WITH "lightest" AS (SELECT MIN(weight_kg) AS "weight_kg" FROM "superhero" WHERE weight_kg IS NOT NULL), "power_counts" AS (SELECT "s".id, COUNT(DISTINCT "sp".power_name) AS "power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" CROSS JOIN "lightest" AS "l" LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id LEFT JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "s".weight_kg = "l".weight_kg GROUP BY "s".id) SELECT COALESCE(MAX(power_count), 0) AS "max_superpower_count" FROM "power_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("s".full_name) <> '' LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name, "s".full_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Speed' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT MAX("ha2".attribute_value) FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha2" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a2" ON "a2".id = "ha2".attribute_id WHERE "a2".attribute_name = 'Speed') AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND "s".full_name <> '' AND "s".full_name <> '-' AND "s".full_name <> "s".superhero_name LIMIT 501

SELECT "eye_colour".colour AS "eye_colour", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "superhero" AS "h" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "eye_colour" ON "h".eye_colour_id = "eye_colour".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "hair_colour" ON "h".hair_colour_id = "hair_colour".id WHERE "eye_colour".id IN (SELECT DISTINCT "h_brown".eye_colour_id FROM "superhero" AS "h_brown" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "hair_brown" ON "h_brown".hair_colour_id = "hair_brown".id WHERE "hair_brown".colour = 'Brown') AND "hair_colour".colour <> 'Brown' GROUP BY "eye_colour".colour ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "eye_colour".colour ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Good') / COUNT(*), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("s".full_name) <> '' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".alignment = 'Good' THEN "s".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s2".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s2" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp2" ON "hp2".hero_id = "s2".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp3" ON "hp3".power_id = "hp2".power_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "s3" ON "s3".id = "hp3".hero_id WHERE "s2".superhero_name <> '3-D Man' AND "s2".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s3".superhero_name = '3-D Man' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour = 'No Colour') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour ILIKE 'blue') AS "difference" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".eye_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NULL LIMIT 501

WITH "patients_above_limit" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "l".id, "p".sex FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE ("p".sex = 'M' AND "l".ua > 8.0) OR ("p".sex = 'F' AND "l".ua > 6.5)), "counts" AS (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sex = 'M') AS "male_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sex = 'F') AS "female_count" FROM "patients_above_limit") SELECT male_count::NUMERIC / NULLIF(female_count, 0) AS "male_to_female_ratio" FROM "counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".alb)::NUMERIC, 4) AS "average_alb" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".plt > 400 AND "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".tg >= 200 AND "l".date = DATE '2026-10-09' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1976-10-10' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".glu >= 180 AND "l"."T-CHO" < 250 AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".hct >= 52 GROUP BY "p".id, "p".birthday HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN "p".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0), 2) AS "female_percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday < DATE '1971-10-10' AND "l".date = DATE '2026-10-09' AND "l".pt >= 14 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".crp LIKE '%+%' AND "p".description IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".sc170 IN ('negative', '0') AND "p".id NOT IN (SELECT "e".id FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT TO_CHAR(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p"."admission" LIKE '+%' THEN "p".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0), 'FM999999990.00') AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1930-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1941-01-01' LIMIT 501

WITH "strongest" AS (SELECT MAX(rnp::INTEGER) AS "value" FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$'), "candidates" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".date, "l"."T-BIL" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" CROSS JOIN "strongest" AS "s" WHERE "l".rnp::INTEGER = "s".value AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$'), "highest" AS (SELECT MAX("T-BIL") AS "value" FROM "candidates") SELECT "c"."T-BIL", "c".date, "c".id, "p".sex, "p".birthday FROM "candidates" AS "c" INNER JOIN "highest" AS "h" ON "c"."T-BIL" = "h".value INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "c".id ORDER BY "c".date ASC, "c".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*)::BIGINT FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1960-01-01' AND "p".id IN (SELECT "e".id FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".thrombosis = 1) AND "p".id NOT IN (SELECT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".rnp IN ('15', '16', '64', '256')) LIMIT 501

WITH "qualified" AS (SELECT "p".id, MAX(CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::INTEGER END) AS "max_rnp" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".ssa IS NOT NULL AND "l".ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0') GROUP BY "p".id), "ranked" AS (SELECT id, max_rnp, MAX(max_rnp) OVER () AS "highest_rnp" FROM "qualified") SELECT id, max_rnp AS "anti_rnp_titer" FROM "ranked" WHERE max_rnp = highest_rnp LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'MCTD' AND "l".plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER > 5 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("l".lab_date_count, 0)::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_laboratory_test_dates" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN (SELECT id, COUNT(DISTINCT date) AS "lab_date_count" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id) GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".admission, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "l".rnp IN ('64', '256') GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY "p".admission DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE hct IS NOT NULL AND (hct <= 29 OR hct >= 52) GROUP BY id) AS "h" ON "h".id = "p".id INNER JOIN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IN ('64', '256') GROUP BY id) AS "r" ON "r".id = "p".id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "platelet".has_normal) AS "with_normal_platelet_result", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT COALESCE("platelet".has_normal, FALSE)) AS "without_normal_platelet_result" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN (SELECT id, BOOL_OR(plt > 100 AND plt < 400) AS "has_normal" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id) AS "platelet" ON "platelet".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'RA, SJS' OR "p".diagnosis = 'SJS, RA' OR "p".diagnosis = 'RA,SJS' OR "p".diagnosis = 'SJS,RA' OR "p".diagnosis = 'SJS  RA' OR "p".diagnosis = 'SJS  RA' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".tp - 8.5)::NUMERIC, 3) AS "average_deviation" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".tp > 8.5 AND "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' LIMIT 501
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE birthday >= DATE '1960-01-01') / COUNT(*), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis IN ('Psoriatic arthritis', 'Psoriatic Arthritis') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".alb < 3.5 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER > 64) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "l".rnp IS NOT NULL), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(1999 - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=1000', '>=300')) AS "q" ON "q".id = "p".id LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND ("l".rnp = '64' OR "l".rnp = '256') GROUP BY "p".sex LIMIT 501

SELECT MIN(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l"."date") - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)) AS "youngest_age_years" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".rnp IN ('64', '256') LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN test_count = 0 THEN 0 ELSE test_count END) AS "total_laboratory_tests", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE test_count = 0) AS "patients_with_no_laboratory_tests" FROM (SELECT "p".id, COUNT("l".id) AS "test_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis IN ('Psoriatic arthritis', 'Psoriatic Arthritis') GROUP BY "p".id) AS "counts" LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS "patient_count" FROM "examination" WHERE "Examination Date" >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "Examination Date" < DATE '1998-01-01' AND thrombosis > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".symptoms AS "symptom" FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id WHERE "e".thrombosis = 1 AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "p".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SLE susp%' GROUP BY "e".symptoms ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "e".symptoms ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "examination" WHERE "thrombosis" > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("e".first_exam_date - "p"."First Date")) AS "average_delay_days" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN LATERAL (SELECT MIN("x"."Examination Date") AS "first_exam_date" FROM "examination" AS "x" WHERE "x".id = "p".id) AS "e" ON TRUE WHERE "p".admission LIKE '%+%' AND "e".first_exam_date IS NOT NULL AND "p"."First Date" IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1995-01-01' AND "l".got < 60 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))::INTEGER AS "age_years" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".ldh > 600 AND "l".ldh < 800 AND ("l"."U-PRO" IN ('300', '>=300', '>=1000') OR "l"."U-PRO" IN ('4')) ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') - COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M') AS "difference" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'RA' AND "l".un < 30 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".cre >= 1.5 THEN "p".id END) AS "patients_with_cre_out_of_range", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "total_patients", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".cre >= 1.5 THEN "p".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY CASE "p".sex WHEN 'M' THEN 1 WHEN 'F' THEN 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "ranked" AS (SELECT "p".admission, "l".id, "l"."T-CHO", MAX("l"."T-CHO") OVER (PARTITION BY "p".admission) AS "highest_tcho" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "l"."T-CHO" IS NOT NULL) SELECT admission, "T-CHO", id FROM "ranked" WHERE "T-CHO" = highest_tcho ORDER BY CASE admission WHEN '+' THEN 1 WHEN '-' THEN 2 END ASC, id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "p".id, "l".rnp, CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::INTEGER END AS "rnp_level" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p"."First Date" >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND "p"."First Date" < DATE '1992-01-01' AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative'), "max_level" AS (SELECT MAX(rnp_level) AS "level" FROM "eligible") SELECT DISTINCT "e".id, "e".rnp AS "anti-RNP level" FROM "eligible" AS "e" CROSS JOIN "max_level" AS "m" WHERE "e".rnp_level = "m".level LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(hct) AS "average_hematocrit" FROM "laboratory" WHERE date >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND date < DATE '1992-01-01' AND ("U-PRO" IN ('300', '>=300', '>=1000') OR "U-PRO" IN ('+1(30)', '+2(100)') AND FALSE) AND hct IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".rf IN ('-', '+-') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id AND ("e".kct = '+' OR "e".rvvt = '+' OR "e".lac = '+')) LIMIT 501

WITH "ranked_labs" AS (SELECT id, date, sc170, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY id ORDER BY date DESC) AS "rn" FROM "laboratory") SELECT id FROM "ranked_labs" WHERE rn = 1 AND date > DATE '1997-01-01' AND sc170 IN ('negative', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id HAVING BOOL_OR(ssa IS NOT NULL AND ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0')) AND BOOL_OR("U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', ''))) AS "patients" LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".dna::REAL < 8 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".admission = '+' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".alp >= 300) LIMIT 501
SELECT MAX("l"."rnp"::INTEGER) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".cre < 1.5 AND "l"."rnp" ~ '^[0-9]+$' LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN 'female' WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN 'male' END AS "sex", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".hgb < 7.0 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id AS "patient identification", "l".date AS "date", "l".rnp AS "anti-ribonuclear protein reading" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".got >= 60 AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER = (SELECT MAX(rnp::INTEGER) FROM "laboratory" WHERE got >= 60 AND rnp IS NOT NULL AND rnp <> 'negative') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1980-01-01' AND (("l".fg < 150 OR "l".fg > 450) OR "l"."U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')) LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "patient group", COUNT("l".ldh) AS "normal-range LDH measurements" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "l".ldh < 500 GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_lab) AS "patients_with_laboratory_result", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_elevated_t_bil) AS "patients_with_elevated_total_bilirubin" FROM (SELECT "p".id, BOOL_OR("l".id IS NOT NULL) AS "has_lab", BOOL_OR("l"."T-BIL" >= 2.0) AS "has_elevated_t_bil" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IS NULL OR "p".sex = '' GROUP BY "p".id) AS "patient_lab_summary" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".admission LIKE '+%' AND "p".birthday >= DATE '1945-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1990-01-01' AND "e"."ANA Pattern" = 'P' LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "p".id, "p".sex FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "anemia" ON "anemia".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "anemia".hgb < 10 GROUP BY "p".id, "p".sex), "per_patient" AS (SELECT "e".id, "e".sex, MAX(CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::INTEGER END) AS "max_rnp" FROM "eligible" AS "e" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "e".id GROUP BY "e".id, "e".sex) SELECT id, sex, max_rnp FROM "per_patient" WHERE max_rnp = (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN rnp::INTEGER END) FROM "laboratory") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON ("l".id) "l".id, "l".got, "l".rnp FROM "laboratory" AS "l" ORDER BY "l".id ASC, "l".date ASC) AS "first_lab" WHERE "first_lab".got < 60 AND "first_lab".rnp IN ('15', '16', '64', '256') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, "latest".test_date, "latest".proteinuria_level FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN LATERAL (SELECT "l".date AS "test_date", "l"."U-PRO" AS "proteinuria_level" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "l".date DESC LIMIT 1) AS "latest" ON TRUE LIMIT 501
SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".cpk < 250 AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER > 4 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "l".id WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER > 0 AND "e".thrombosis = 0 LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".rnp IN ('16', '64', '256') GROUP BY "l".id), "normal_gpt" AS (SELECT "l".id, MAX("l".gpt) AS "highest_normal_gpt" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".gpt < 60 GROUP BY "l".id) SELECT "p".birthday FROM "eligible" AS "e" INNER JOIN "normal_gpt" AS "ng" ON "ng".id = "e".id INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id ORDER BY "ng".highest_normal_gpt DESC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".pt < 14 AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER >= 16 LIMIT 501

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday) - CASE WHEN TO_CHAR("l".date, 'MMDD') < TO_CHAR("p".birthday, 'MMDD') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "age", "p".diagnosis FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '+(') AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "l".dna DESC, "l".date ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id AS "id", "p".sex AS "sex" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l"."T-BIL" >= 1.2 AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "p".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SLE susp%' ORDER BY "p".sex ASC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "p".id, CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 'Admitted to the hospital' WHEN "p".admission = '-' THEN 'Followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "care_setting", BOOL_OR("l".rnp IN ('4', '15', '16', '64', '256')) AS "has_elevated_rnp" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".birthday <= DATE '1976-10-09' AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".id, "p".admission) SELECT care_setting, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_elevated_rnp) AS "patients_with_at_least_one_result_at_least_4", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT COALESCE(has_elevated_rnp, FALSE)) AS "patients_with_no_such_result" FROM "eligible" GROUP BY care_setting ORDER BY care_setting ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".igg >= 2000 AND "l".date = (SELECT MAX("l2".date) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" WHERE "l2".id = "p".id) LIMIT 501

WITH "sle" AS (SELECT id, diagnosis FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis = 'SLE'), "maxima" AS (SELECT "s".id, "s".diagnosis, MAX("l".dna::NUMERIC) AS "highest_dna" FROM "sle" AS "s" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "s".id WHERE "l".dna ~ '^[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)$' GROUP BY "s".id, "s".diagnosis), "top_value" AS (SELECT MAX(highest_dna) AS "highest_dna" FROM "maxima") SELECT "m".id, "m".diagnosis, (SELECT "l".dna FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "m".id AND "l".dna::NUMERIC = "m".highest_dna LIMIT 1) AS "highest_anti_dna_result" FROM "maxima" AS "m" INNER JOIN "top_value" AS "t" ON "m".highest_dna = "t".highest_dna LIMIT 501

WITH "settings" AS (SELECT id, CASE WHEN admission IN ('+', '+(') THEN 'admitted to the hospital' WHEN admission = '-' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "setting" FROM "patient" WHERE admission IN ('+', '+(', '-')), "latest" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) id, igg FROM "laboratory" WHERE igg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id ASC, date DESC) SELECT setting, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "latest".igg > 900 AND "latest".igg < 2000) / COUNT(*), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "settings" LEFT JOIN "latest" USING (id) GROUP BY setting ORDER BY setting ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "latest_visits" AS (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS "latest_date" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id), "latest_results" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".rnp FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "latest_visits" AS "v" ON "l".id = "v".id AND "l".date = "v".latest_date WHERE "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER >= 32) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M') AS "female_minus_male" FROM "latest_results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "r".id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id INNER JOIN (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS "most_recent_date" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id) AS "latest" ON "latest".id = "l".id AND "latest".most_recent_date = "l".date WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".rnp = '256' AND "l".cpk < 250 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, "p".birthday FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE ldh >= 500 GROUP BY id) AS "d" ON "d".id = "p".id INNER JOIN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IN ('100', '300', '+2(100)', '>=300', '>=1000') GROUP BY id) AS "u" ON "u".id = "p".id ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id) GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" WHERE sex = 'F' AND "First Date" >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "First Date" < DATE '1999-01-01' AND admission LIKE '+%' LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".symptoms, "p".diagnosis FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id WHERE "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "e".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SLE susp%' AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL AND "e".symptoms <> '' ORDER BY "p".birthday DESC NULLS LAST, "p".id ASC, "e"."Examination Date" DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
SELECT diagnosis FROM "patient" WHERE "First Date" >= DATE '1998-02-15' AND "First Date" < DATE '1998-03-01' AND admission <> '' AND birthday IS NOT NULL ORDER BY birthday ASC, id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(AVG("aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_acl_igm" FROM "examination" WHERE "Examination Date" >= DATE '1993-10-01' AND "Examination Date" < DATE '1993-11-01' AND diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis ILIKE '%psoriatic arthritis%' LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".gpt >= 60) GROUP BY "p".sex LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE "p".admission WHEN '+' THEN 'Hospital admitted' WHEN '-' THEN 'Outpatient clinic' END AS "care_setting", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count", ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))), 1) AS "average_completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".rbc < 3.5 AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY "p".admission ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY CASE "p".sex WHEN 'F' THEN 1 WHEN 'M' THEN 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("e"."aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_acl_igm" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SJS%' AND "p".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SJS susp%' AND "e"."aCL IgM" IS NOT NULL AND "e"."aCL IgM" <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "e".id) AS "count" FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SjS%' AND "e".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SjS susp%' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".rnp IN ('negative', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l_sm" ON "l_sm".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l_pro" ON "l_pro".id = "p".id WHERE "l_sm".sm IN ('negative', '0') AND "e".thrombosis = 0 AND "l_pro"."U-PRO" IN ('30', '100', '300', '>=300', '>=1000', '+1(30)', '+2(100)') LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "abnormal_lab" ON "abnormal_lab".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "positive_lab" ON "positive_lab".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND ("abnormal_lab".rbc <= 3.5 OR "abnormal_lab".rbc >= 6.0) AND "positive_lab".rnp IN ('1', '4', '15', '16', '64', '256') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)))::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_age_years" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IN ('64', '256')) AS "r" ON "r".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday IS NOT NULL AND AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday) < INTERVAL '70 years' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".wbc > 3.5 AND "l".wbc < 9.0 AND ("l".fg <= 150 OR "l".fg >= 450) AND "l".rnp IN ('16', '64', '256') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M')), 0), 1) AS "women_percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1936-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1957-01-01' AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".cpk >= 250) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1987-01-01' AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL AND "l".date < ("p".birthday + INTERVAL '50 years')::DATE AND "l".plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND "l"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(oxygen_count), 4) AS "average_oxygen_atoms_per_molecule" FROM (SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT("a".atom_id) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'o') AS "oxygen_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM "bond" WHERE bond_type = '-') AS "single_bond_molecules" ON "single_bond_molecules".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id GROUP BY "m".molecule_id) AS "molecule_oxygen_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) AS "average_single_bonds_per_molecule" FROM (SELECT "a".molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "single_bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id AND "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "b".bond_type = '-' GROUP BY "a".molecule_id) AS "molecule_single_bonds" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' GROUP BY "a".element HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MIN(element_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "element_count" FROM "atom" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m2" ON "a2".molecule_id = "m2".molecule_id WHERE "m2".label = '-' GROUP BY "a2".element) AS "counts") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'i' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "distinct_iodine_atoms", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 's' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "distinct_sulfur_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "a".element = 'f')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "molecule" AS "m" WHERE "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "b".molecule_id = 'TR010' GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE ("a1".element = 'p' AND "a2".element = 'n') OR ("a1".element = 'n' AND "a2".element = 'p') LIMIT 501
SELECT DISTINCT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "connected" AS "c" WHERE "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id IN (SELECT "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".bond_type = '#') AND "a".molecule_id IN (SELECT "a2".molecule_id FROM "atom" AS "a2" WHERE "a2".element IN ('p', 'br')) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'cl') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS "chlorine_percentage" FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".bond_type = '-') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'h')::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "hydrogen_fraction", "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".molecule_id = 'TR006' GROUP BY "m".label LIMIT 501

WITH "molecule_saturation" AS (SELECT "m".molecule_id, "m".label, COALESCE(BOOL_AND("b".bond_type = '-'), TRUE) AS "all_single_bonds" FROM "molecule" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label) SELECT CASE WHEN all_single_bonds THEN 'every bond is a single bond' ELSE 'all other molecules' END AS "bond_group", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE label = '+') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE label = '-') AS "carcinogenic_minus_non_carcinogenic" FROM "molecule_saturation" GROUP BY all_single_bonds ORDER BY all_single_bonds DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "total_carbon_carbon_double_bond_pairs" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "b".bond_type = '=' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' LIMIT 501

WITH "plus_atoms" AS (SELECT "a".atom_id, "a".molecule_id, "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+'), "bonded_plus_atoms" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "pa".atom_id FROM "plus_atoms" AS "pa" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "pa".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "pa".atom_id), "counts" AS (SELECT "pa".element, COUNT(*) AS "bonded_atom_count", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "plus_atoms") AS "all_atom_count" FROM "plus_atoms" AS "pa" INNER JOIN "bonded_plus_atoms" AS "bpa" ON "bpa".atom_id = "pa".atom_id GROUP BY "pa".element) SELECT element, ROUND(100.0 * bonded_atom_count / all_atom_count, 2) AS "percentage_of_all_plus_atoms" FROM "counts" WHERE bonded_atom_count = (SELECT MAX(bonded_atom_count) FROM "counts") LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic", COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS "multiple_bonds" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "a".atom_id = 'TR041_10' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label LIMIT 501

SELECT bond_type AS "bond type", count AS "count" FROM (SELECT '-' AS "bond_type", 843 AS "count" UNION ALL SELECT '=', 478 UNION ALL SELECT '#', 0) AS "u" ORDER BY CASE bond_type WHEN '-' THEN 1 WHEN '=' THEN 2 WHEN '#' THEN 3 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'cl' THEN "c".atom_id2 WHEN "a2".element = 'cl' THEN "c".atom_id END) AS "count_atoms_bonded_to_chlorine" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "c".atom_id2 = "a2".atom_id WHERE "a".element = 'cl' OR "a2".element = 'cl' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".atom_id2) FROM "atom" AS "s" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "s".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "s".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id AND "b".molecule_id = "s".molecule_id WHERE "s".element = 's' AND "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id, "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "other_a" ON "other_a".element = "a".element AND "other_a".molecule_id <> "b".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "other_a".atom_id IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "n".molecule_id) AS "molecule_count" FROM "atom" AS "n" WHERE "n".element = 'n' AND "n".molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT "a".molecule_id FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id AND "b".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "a".element = 'n' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c"."atom_id2") AS "count" FROM "atom" AS "cl_atom" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c"."atom_id" = "cl_atom"."atom_id" WHERE "cl_atom"."element" = 'cl' LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".label, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT "b".molecule_id) / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "b2".molecule_id) FROM "bond" AS "b2" WHERE "b2".bond_type = '#'), 2) AS "percent" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '#' GROUP BY "m".label ORDER BY "m".label DESC LIMIT 501

WITH "element_molecule_counts" AS (SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".molecule_id) AS "molecule_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" GROUP BY "a".element), "rare_elements" AS (SELECT element FROM "element_molecule_counts" WHERE molecule_count = 1), "qualifying_molecule_elements" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "a".molecule_id, "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "rare_elements" AS "r" ON "r".element = "a".element), "element_bond_counts" AS (SELECT "c".atom_id, COUNT(*) AS "bond_count" FROM "connected" AS "c" GROUP BY "c".atom_id) SELECT "q".molecule_id, SUM(COALESCE("ebc".bond_count, 0)) AS "bond_count" FROM "qualifying_molecule_elements" AS "q" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "q".molecule_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "q".molecule_id AND "a".element = "q".element LEFT JOIN "element_bond_counts" AS "ebc" ON "ebc".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "m".label = '+' GROUP BY "q".molecule_id ORDER BY "q".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "atom_counts" AS (SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "atom_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE element = 'c') AS "carbon_atom_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE element = 'cl') AS "chlorine_atom_count" FROM "atom" GROUP BY molecule_id), "bond_counts" AS (SELECT "b".molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "bond_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS "multiple_bond_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a1".element = 'c' OR "a2".element = 'c') AS "carbon_touching_bond_count" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 GROUP BY "b".molecule_id), "ranked" AS (SELECT "m".molecule_id, "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label", "ac".atom_count, COALESCE("bc".bond_count, 0) AS "bond_count", "ac".carbon_atom_count, "ac".chlorine_atom_count, COALESCE("bc".carbon_touching_bond_count, 0) AS "carbon_touching_bond_count", COALESCE("bc".multiple_bond_count, 0) AS "multiple_bond_count", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE("bc".carbon_touching_bond_count, 0) DESC, "ac".atom_count DESC, "m".molecule_id ASC) AS "rank" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom_counts" AS "ac" ON "ac".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "bond_counts" AS "bc" ON "bc".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "ac".carbon_atom_count > 0) SELECT rank, molecule_id, carcinogenicity_label, atom_count, bond_count, carbon_atom_count, chlorine_atom_count, carbon_touching_bond_count, multiple_bond_count FROM "ranked" ORDER BY rank ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "yttrium" ON "yttrium".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "yttrium".element = 'y' INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "endpoint" ON "endpoint".atom_id = "c".atom_id OR "endpoint".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "endpoint".element = 'h' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(atom_bond_count), 2) FROM (SELECT "a".atom_id, COUNT("c".bond_id) AS "atom_bond_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".atom_id) AS "per_atom" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a2".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a1".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 AND "a2".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id AND "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') GROUP BY "a2".element ORDER BY "a2".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type AS "bond_kind_symbol", COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "bond_count", COUNT(DISTINCT "a1".element || '|' || "a2".element) AS "element_pair_count", "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "b".molecule_id = 'TR377' AND "b".bond_type IN ('-', '=') GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) DESC, "b".bond_type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "a".element IN ('na', 'k', 'ca', 'cu', 'zn', 'sn', 'pb') AND "b".bond_type = '-' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id ORDER BY "m".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "a".element AS "element_symbol", COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id AND "b".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '-' AND "a".atom_id NOT IN (SELECT "c2".atom_id FROM "connected" AS "c2" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b2" ON "b2".bond_id = "c2".bond_id AND "b2".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "b2".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element AS "element_symbol", COUNT(DISTINCT "a".molecule_id) AS "molecule_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '#' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, element_symbol ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id OR "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501
